kebab_example: aliyun imp create-sensitive-word --app-id 7m000q --word-list 测试敏感词 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSensitiveWord

parameters.help_en: The application ID, which is generated when you create the application in the console. The ID contains lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户的应用ID，在控制台创建应用时生成。包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The list of sensitive words. Sensitive words support Chinese characters, letters, and digits. English sensitive words are not supported. You can create up to 100 sensitive words at a time. Each sensitive word cannot exceed 20 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 敏感词列表，敏感词支持中文、字母数字，暂不支持英文敏感词，一次最多可以创建100个敏感词，单个敏感词的长度不得超过20个字符
parameters.name: word_list

Result.description_en: The result returned for the create sensitive words operation
Result.description_zh: 调用创建敏感词的返回结果

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful

Result.title_en: 调用发送直播间弹幕的返回结果。
Result.title_zh: 调用发送直播间弹幕的返回结果。
